name: Vighnesh Iyer
headline: Where cinematic vision meets *user experience*.
intro:
I'm Vighnesh — For over three years, I worked in the VFX industry, using 3D modeling and graphics design to build immersive visual environments for major motion pictures. Today, I bring that same spatial awareness and visual precision to product design—moving from cinematic storytelling to user-centric UI/UX problem-solving. 

I don't just design interfaces; I create intuitive digital journeys.
tagline: Where cinematic vision meets user experience. Bringing 3D visualisation expertise to UI/UX design.
